negative_reviews.author: Iman Butt
negative_reviews.text: The food was delicious, the broth was rich and flavourful, the noodles were perfectly cooked and the steak was tender. Only reason why I didn’t give it a 5 star is due to the unwelcoming staff. As we went in a member of staff came to sit us down after a 5 mins wait and didn’t say hi or anything just asked if we had any allergies. We sat down with the menus and 20 mins later no one had come to us to ask if we had ordered or attempted to take our order. Flagging the servers down was basically impossible even though it was not that busy, as they all just avoid eye contact and just stood chatting to each other or slowly cleaning tables. But the food was good so we tried ignoring all that. In the end, after finishing our food a server came and took our dishes and asked if that was all or if we wanted to order anything else. We said no we’re done that’s all. We thought that was enough and she would come back with the card machine to take our payments like we had seen her do for other tables. But she just left us there for another 10 minutes till we flagged her down and payed. Why was it so hard for us just to pay for our food and get going.

negative_reviews.author: Sundus
negative_reviews.text: Decided to pop in here for a late lunch with my family. We were stood waiting for a good while to be seated. When we did eventually get seated, it took about ten minutes to get the waiter and waitresses attention. There were only three members of staff serving the whole restaurant which was quite full. We placed our order with one of our mains and one starter arriving within about 15 minutes. We then waited around 20 minutes patiently wondering where the rest of our meal was - we were a table of five and had ordered four dishes to share. We reminded the staff about our order and it seemed they had forgotten or misplaced the order? Another ten mins or so later our food was brought out. We weren’t once asked if the food was ok. Service was extremely slow. Our meal came to £64 for what felt like a really weird and disjointed meal. The service charge was cancelled upon our request but tbh I wouldn’t eat there again. The food was very much overpriced and overrated. When the remainder of our food finally arrived it wasn’t even very hot, and the noodles tastes bland. The whole plate looked like it had been made in a rush. Furthermore, the floor was extremely slippery throughout and with other customers slipping on the stairs to the toilets. A member of staff actually slipped too and several children and other customers were scared to used the stairs for fear of also slipping. A hugely disappointing experience. I will never eat here again.

negative_reviews.author: Levi Litman
negative_reviews.text:
Went in last week with a group of 5. Food was actually pretty nice. However the service was horrific. When ordering we asked the waitress if the food could all come out together as we had a mix of smaller sharing plates and larger dishes. The waitress assured us this would be fine.

This was in fact not the case and there was a 30 minute wait before our Sushi came in comparison to the rest of the dishes. The other dishes were a slightly staggered delay which was fine. But this service, especially when they were not at full capacity, ruined our experience.

We had other staff double checking what we had ordered, it felt like it was the first night they had opened.

When we complained we had other staff tell us it would be ready when it was cooked. This is completely fine and I understand this, but they should then therefore make this explicitly clear when ordering. If we would have known that we would have ordered differently.

They did deduct 10% from our bill as a goodwill gesture. But I'd be hesitant to return to be completely honest.

negative_reviews.author: Ekonomist Official
negative_reviews.text:
I went here yesterday wi the my wife, the theme and decors is great but thats the only thing. The waiters and workers are clueless about the menu and Ive never experienced such poor luck laster service in my life.
They sat us down and i had to wave 5x to get someones attention, after taking my order and not being able to answer any of my food based questions i ordered 2x sushi dishes, gyoza and the steak soup dish.

The sushi were horrible and poor quality, we wanted to eat fresh made authentic sushi however these were premade/purchased clearly from somewhere like wasabi, or a mass production company. In tesco you buy crab sticks, their sushi had cut piece of crabsticks you buy from the fridge section in a Tesco. Not real crab. Same for the salmon sushi piece. The steak main was tasteless, noodles undercooked so i decided to order another dish, by the way the steak was five tiny cuts nothing like the images. I ordered chicken yakisoba and man, dissapointed first bite i took was to check the chicken was cooked, and it was pink and slimey inside. So i asked for the bill paid for what i had and i left.

Now i am not a freebie hunter or a cheap scape, i am a experienced worker of hospitality and i have worked in fine Japanese Hot Stone style restaurants so i can define good food between wasabi style premade and heated food in a pan. Nothing is cooked fresh, food is bland and disgusting, the staff are vert unattentative, i had to ask them to give me cutlery when my food came out as i had none and they never realised, also i had to ask them to take empty plates when done, also i asked for plates for me and my partner to eat off as we were sharing the dishes and they gave me a wooden board which i refused and asked for plates, wooden boards are to place and display food on for customers to eat off.

Very dissatisfied and dissapointed, dont make yourself look like a authentic fresh Japanese restaurant when youre basically a fast food chain style place.

negative_reviews.text: Food was lovely. Great sushi, katsu curry etc. Service was a let down. Very slow on a quiet early evening.
